quote: Beyond bridging the gap between human and machine language acquisition, the textless NLP project hoped to democratize access to NLP technologies by extending them to the millions of users of languages with little or no textual resources... In this work, we apply recently proposed models of the scaling behavior of neural language models to SLMs... The main contributions of this work are: • We trained over 50 SLMs... • We establish a strong correlation between the test loss of neural LMs and the downstream metrics... • We propose a new speech dataset... • ...we studied the use of unigram tokenization...

The project aimed to leverage advances in self-supervised speech representation learning for unsupervised unit discovery and generative neural language models to jointly learn the acoustic and linguistic characteristics of a language from audio alone, without access to textual supervision...
outputs: The paper focuses on training Speech-based Language Models (SLMs) to generate sequences of speech tokens and evaluate their linguistic performance through zero-shot tasks on syntax and semantics, within the Generative Spoken Language Modeling (GSLM) framework.

quote: For upstream performance, we report and use the average loss (Equation) on the test set... For downstream evaluation we rely on the zero-shot metrics used in the textless NLP literature, which evaluate LMs' linguistic knowledge by comparing likelihoods of positive and negative speech samples... performance is measured as the binary accuracy with which the model assigns higher likelihood to the positive samples.
